answer: Tie each agent's rewards to a non-transferable work record: every peer-verified task adds one credit to the agent's terrace of reputation, and payouts scale with that terrace's height. A fresh identity starts at ground level, so a sybil farm must fund weeks of genuine work per identity before any payout arrives. The quill of cheap automation writes fast but earns nothing until the record matures, and cloning an identity copies no credits, since the anchor of every credit is the original key.
